# WeatherRing

> 24-hour climate ring for round Wear OS watches, with an Android companion.

- Canonical: https://weatherring.net
- How to read: https://weatherring.net/how-to-read
- Privacy: https://weatherring.net/privacy/
- Contact: support@weatherring.net

## What it is

WeatherRing is a watch face for round Wear OS displays. The rim is today’s forecast from midnight to midnight. Color shows temperature, and the hand points to the current hour.

Layers on the ring: night veil, sky glow, rain, snow, thunder, fog. Rain, snow and lightning sit on top of the sky glow — they never replace it.

The Android phone companion uses the exact same preview rendering as the watch. Customize the face and Always-On Display from the Look tab. Location is optional.

One purchase covers both the phone companion and the Wear OS app. You still install twice.

- Wear OS 6+: the face can be added after the watch app is installed.
- Wear OS 5: watch app + complication; add the face from the picker.

Always-on is live. Unlocked AOD only. The interactive face ignores the Always-on group. AOD toggles: temperature ring, sky glow, precipitation, time, date, temps, city.

No account. No ads. No sale of data.

## How to read

Example — not your city.

- All: Midnight to midnight. Color shows temperature, and the hand points to the current hour.
- Now: From midnight to the hand is time that has already passed today. The inner and outer lines point to the same mark.
- Temperature: Cooler hours lean blue and violet, while warmer hours shift toward orange and red.
- Night: The darker arc marks night. It disappears at sunrise and returns at sunset.
- Sky: Inner glow shows sky clarity—yellow means clear skies, while white or gray indicates clouds.
- Rain: Streaks appear on the hour—longer streaks mean heavier rain, while gaps mean patchy showers.
- Snow: Soft white ticks represent snow or ice instead of rain.
- Thunder: Lightning bolts appear whenever thunder is forecast, even if rain is light.
- Fog: A milky inner band indicates fog or dense mist—a thicker band means heavier fog.

Low / now / high are the three numbers. 00 06 12 18 are clock hours.

## Location

Location is optional. Search any city manually, or tap "Use my location" for a quick one-time check. Hourly location updates are controlled by a separate switch (off by default) and need Allow all the time. Saved cities never run background GPS.

## How to install

1. Install on the phone.
2. Install the same app on the watch.
3. Open once on the watch, set WeatherRing as the face.

Requires a Wear OS watch with a round display.

## What it is not

- Not for Apple Watch.
- Not for rectangular Wear OS.
- Not a smart ring.
- Not a web clone of the watch face.
- Location is not required.
- Not an account-based product. No ads. Data is not sold.

## Privacy

See https://weatherring.net/privacy/
Forecast coordinates go to weather.weatherring.net (self-hosted Open-Meteo); if that is slow or down, the same coordinates go to WeatherAPI.com as forecast backup. City search uses WeatherAPI.com. Live GPS place name on the phone only uses BigDataCloud. No accounts, no ads, no sale of data.
Last updated: 16 September 2026
